book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Xammaqiza Yohannisi Kiittida Asata
Yesusikka bana kaalliza tammanne nam7u asatas azazo immi wursidaappe guye tamaarsanaassinne sabbakanaas Galilan diza katamata bides.
Yohannisi qasho keeththan dishe Kirstoosi ooththiza hanota siyidi bana kaallizayta izakko yeddidi, «As ashshizaadey yaana geetettiday neneyee? Hara naaginoo?» giidi oychchides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Biidi intte siyidayssanne intte be7idayssa Yohannisas yootite.
Qooqeti xeelleettes; wobbeti hemetteettes; inchchirachcha hargizayti paxeettes; tulleti siyeettes; hayqqidayti hayqoppe paxi dendeettes; manqotas Mishiraachcho qaalay yooteettes.
Tanan dhuphettonttaadey anjjettidaade» gides.
Yohannisa kaallizayti bidaappe guye Yesusikka asaas Yohannisa gishshas, «Ay beyanaas duge bazzo bidetii? Carkoy qaaththiza shomboqo beyanaas yidetii?
Woykko ay beyanaas kezidetii? Lo7o may7o may7i dizayta beyana yidetii? Lo7o may7o may7idi lo7izayti kawota keeththan deettes.
Histtiin ay beyana kezidetii? Nabe beyana kezidetii? Ee, ta inttes gays, nabeppe aadhdhizayssa beyanaassa.
«Ta inttes tumu gays; maccassafe yelettida asappe xammaqiza Yohannisa misatiza asi biitta bolla dendibeenna. Gidikkoka Xoossa Kawoteththan as ubbaafe laafa asi Yohannisappe aadhdhana.
«Xammaqiza Yohannisa wodeppe haa simmiin ha7i gakkanaas Salo Kawoteththaya daro baaxe bolla dawus. Mino asati xalla izo demmana.
Nabetikka Muse wogaykka wuri Yohannisa wode gakkanaas buroppe hananayssa yootida.
Histtiko intte ekkana koykko izi yaana geetettida Eelaasi izakko!
Siyiza hayththi diza asi siyo!
«Hayssa ha wode asaa aazan leemisoo? Giyan uttidi ba laggeta, ‹Nu inttes diith diixxiin intte duribeekketa! Yeeho zilas zilaliin yeekkibeekketa!› giza nayta misateettes.
Yohannisi muussafenne ushshafe naagettidi yida gishshas, ‹Izi daydanththara dees› gida.
Ta Asa Nay mashenne uyashe yiin, ‹Hayssi miidi kallontta asa, ushshanchcha, qaraxa shiishshizaytassinne nagaranchchatas laggeko!› gida. Gido attiin Xoossa erateththi ba ooson xilladus» gides.
Ammanontta Ixxida Gishshas Walassettida Katamata

Hessafe guye Yesusi izi malaatata ooththida katama asay maaroteththan gelontta aggida gishshas, «Kuraziinenne Betesayda! Inttena aayye ana! Intte bolla oosettida malatay Xiroose bollanne Sidoona bolla oosettidaakko istti maaqa
may7idinne bidinththan uttidi beni maaroteththan gelanakkoshin.
Hessa gishshas tani inttes gizay pirda gallas inttefe aadhdhi Xiroosessinne Sidoonas qixaatey kawuyana.
«Hanne Qifirnahoome pude salo dhoqqu dhoqqu gaanaas koyadii? Gido attiin neni duge Si7oole wodhdhandasa; ne bolla oosettida malatay Sodoomen oosettidaakko Sodoomey hach gakkanaas daanakkoshin.
Hessa gishshas ta nena gizay pirda gallas qixaatey neeppe Sodoomes kawuyana» gides.
Kirstoosi Immiza Shempo
He wode Yesusi, «Salonne sa7a Godoo! Ta Aawawu! Hayssa daro eranchchatappenne cinccatappe qottada qeeri naytas ne qonccisida gishshas ta nena galatays.
Ta Aawawu! Ee hayssi ne sinththan lo7o ne shene gidi beettides.
«Wurikka ta Aawappe taas imettides; Aawappe attiin Naaza gishshas eriza asi baa; qasse Naazappenne Naazi ba shenen qonccisida asappe haray aawaa eriza asi baa.
«Toohoy deexxidaytoo, daaburdaytoo, intte wurikka taakko haa yiite; tanikka inttes shempo immana.
Ta qambara tookkite; taappeka tamaarte; tani ta wozinan aadanne ashke; intte shemppos intte shempo demmana.
Ta qambaray shaykonne ta toohoy kawushsha» gides.

footnotes.text: -21 Maaqa: Maaqa geetettizayssi issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan waaro geetettees.
